shortDescription: Yanghe Co. and Joybuy, JD.com’s European online retail business, signed a strategic cooperation agreement in London on August 27, according to Jiemian News. The two sides said they will jointly expand in Europe and accelerate Yanghe’s overseas localization strategy.
